title: AWS SaaS example architecture
notes: Original file stored base64+deflate compressed inside the <diagram> tag (standard draw.io compression). Decoded to plain <mxGraphModel> XML for source.xml via: base64-decode -> zlib.decompress(raw, -15) -> urllib.parse.unquote. Diagram shows a 3-tier AWS web app: Route53 -> ELB (web tier) -> EC2 C3 instances (Auto Scaling) -> ELB (app tier) -> EC2 M4 instances (Auto Scaling) -> RDS Master/Slave (Cross-AZ replication), plus a CloudFront CDN -> S3 static assets path.
